# Data Engineer (m/f/x), Ghent

We're a 120-person scale-up in logistics software and we're growing our data platform team.

## What you'll do

- Build and run batch and streaming pipelines in Python and SQL
- Own our Airflow deployment and move critical flows to Kafka-based streaming
- Work with analysts and product owners on data models with dbt
- Keep data quality high with tests, monitoring and clear ownership

## What you bring

- 3+ years of experience as a data engineer
- Strong Python and SQL
- Experience with Airflow or a similar orchestrator in production
- Experience with Kafka, Docker and a cloud platform (AWS or GCP)
- Dutch and English at a professional level
- A degree in computer science or equivalent experience

## Nice to have

- dbt, Terraform, Kubernetes
